text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and C at sizable gains felt satisfying, but I should set sale rules in advance instead of chasing that feeling.","I sold Stock A for a small gain, then mostly held as my account declined; I should review each position against my plan rather than let loss aversion or inaction decide.","The ups and downs over these periods did not reveal a dependable trend, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves and trade in line with my goals and risk limits."]}
